topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I can't believe I stumbled upon this, honestly. Their bucket list, just lying there, and it's like everything I thought I knew hit the floor, right next to it. It's full of places we talked about, dreams we said were ours. But looking closer, there's so much more, stuff that seems completely new, like they've been planning a whole other life. I mean, I get having private thoughts, but this? This feels like a whole different world they haven't even hinted at. Why didn't they ever share any of this with me? We’re supposed to be a team, right? It’s like I’m reading a story about someone I don’t even recognize.
